title: Naming feelings
examples: What does your face look like when you are happy?
Can you show me how you look when you are angry?
What does your body do when you feel worried?

explain.say: Feelings are what you feel inside. Happy and sad are feelings. Every feeling has a name.
When you feel happy, you may smile. You may want to jump or dance.
When you feel sad, your face may look down. You may want to sit quietly or cry.
When you feel angry, your body may feel hot. Your hands may make fists. You may want to stamp your feet.
When you feel worried, your tummy may feel fluttery. Your heart may beat fast.
All feelings are okay. Say the name of your feeling. Then a grown-up can help you.

faq.a: A feeling is what you feel inside your body and your mind. Happy, sad and angry are feelings.
asks: How do I know how I feel?

faq.a: You can feel angry when something seems unfair, or when something is hard. It is okay to feel angry.

faq.q: Is it okay to cry when I am sad?
faq.a: Yes, it is okay to cry when you are sad. Crying helps let the sad feeling out a little bit.

faq.q: How do I show I am worried?
faq.a: You can say, I feel worried. Your body may show it too, with a fluttery tummy or fast breathing.

faq.q: Does being happy mean I never get sad?
faq.a: No. You feel lots of different feelings every day. It is normal to feel both happy and sad.

facts: Feelings are normal parts of being a person.
Your body can give clues about how you feel.
Smiling is a way to show you are happy.
Taking deep breaths can help when you feel worried.

quiz.say: Your tummy feels fluttery. Tap the feeling.
quiz.why: A fluttery tummy is a body clue for worry. Many people feel it when they are worried.

wrong.0: When you feel happy, you are more likely to smile and feel light.
wrong.2: When you feel angry, your body is more likely to feel hot.

quiz.say: Kofi feels angry. Tap what his body may do.
quiz.why: Angry feelings can make your body want to move hard. Kofi may stamp his feet.

wrong.1: A big smile is a clue for a happy feeling.
wrong.2: Falling asleep is a clue for a tired body.

quiz.say: Look at Mei’s face. Tap how she feels.
quiz.why: Mei has a tear and her mouth turns down. Those are clues for a sad feeling.

wrong.0: A happy face has a smile that turns up.
wrong.1: An angry face often has eyebrows pulled down and tight lips.
